title: Deeper/broader R2013 DXF ACIS storage source-conflict and carrier evidence
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local plan/test-owner reconciliation
scope: Compare Autodesk's versioned R2013 DXF reference and current 3DSOLID field table with the version-specific SAT/SAB carrier descriptions in ezdxf 1.4.5 documentation
Resolve whether generic group-1/3 fields establish the R2013+ ACIS carrier location
Refine the existing PAR-07/S2/S8 evidence matrix without adding per-slice validation or an external dependency

method.limitations: The Autodesk 2013 reference was searched for ACDSDATA and ACDSRECORD and neither term was present; this documents an omission in that manual, not proof that the carrier is absent from R2013 files. The ezdxf 1.4.5 documentation is self-contradictory. The tagged source archive was not fetched/inspected, and no candidate file was opened by AutoCAD, BricsCAD, ODA, or another independent runtime.

sources.revision: Official AutoCAD 2013 reference PDF and Autodesk current 3DSOLID page reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The 2013 ENTITIES table lists AcDbModelerGeometry, group 70, proprietary groups 1/3, AcDb3dSolid, and history group 350. Searches of the reference returned no ACDSDATA or ACDSRECORD entries. Autodesk's current 3DSOLID page repeats the generic group-1/3 schema without a version-specific carrier-location rule.
sources.limits: The absence of a term from these references is not evidence that modern DXF data has no ACDSDATA/SAB route. The group table is insufficient to settle version-dependent carrier location.

sources.revision: Stable documentation identifies ezdxf 1.4.5; release tag points to 84ae319; PyPI source archive uploaded 2026-10-16 with SHA-256 a6c3bbc1a65ce764d97c5beafe6ae693d8ed14c6cdae366b50e1974a79d4a00a
sources.observed: The detailed ACIS guide describes SAT for DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB for R2013/R2018, documents export_sab() and body_from_mesh(), and claims exported flat polyhedra load in Autodesk products and BricsCAD. It limits geometry to simple/known structures, says unsupported structures can be lost, and has no ACIS kernel. Its FAQ contradicts the detailed API by saying it writes SAT only and provides no ACIS creation/editing.
sources.limits: This pass did not inspect the tagged sdist, bind the stable documentation build to the exact artifact, run the authoring API, or reproduce the native-acceptance statement. Keep the documentation conflict unresolved at source/runtime level.

references: PAR-07/S8 ACDSDATA transport and owner/key checks
sources.observed: Existing work already has an ezdxf-generated AC1027 faceted SAB candidate plus generated local ACDSDATA replay, key-remap, multi-record, and continuity controls. No duplicate runtime generation, external fixture, CTest, or per-slice peer run is required for this research update.
sources.limits: Marker-carrier tests and same-generator structural readback do not independently validate arbitrary ACIS topology, DWG DataStorage association, or native CAD acceptance.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies that Autodesk's generic group-1/3 table is not a complete R2013+ carrier-location contract. Preserves the unresolved ezdxf detailed-guide/FAQ conflict, narrows ezdxf's optional role to faceted control authoring, and requires separate version, carrier, owner/key, payload, geometry, and consumer evidence. Existing fast-first implementation cadence and all support/J gates remain unchanged.
